mapper.select: SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM sys_user WHERE role = #{role} ORDER BY id LIMIT 1
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE username = #{username} OR phone = #{phone}
SELECT COUNT(*) FROM sys_user WHERE id <> #{id} AND (username = #{username} OR phone = #{phone})
mapper.update: UPDATE sys_user SET role = #{role}, real_name = #{realName}, deleted = false, deleted_time = NULL, disabled = false, disabled_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE sys_user SET deleted = false, deleted_time = NULL, disabled = false, disabled_time = NULL WHERE id = #{id} AND role <> #{adminRole}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM sys_user WHERE id = #{id} AND role <> #{adminRole} AND deleted = true
DELETE FROM sys_user WHERE deleted = true AND role <> #{adminRole} AND deleted_time < #{expireBefore}
